observations.result: Workspace settings validation, fenced-heading line extraction and outline/backlink context tests pass; the focused slice covers 9 tests with 27 expectations.
Main, preload and renderer bundles compile with source/live-preview/reading mode controls, tabs, quick switching, outline/backlinks and settings IPC wiring.

implemented: Added explicit source, live-preview and reading mode controls with a safe DOM-only preview for headings and task lines; source bytes remain authoritative for edits and writes.
Added in-session note tabs that retain revision, dirty and source content state while switching notes, plus a keyboard-reachable quick switcher backed by the vault search/index contract.
Added outline extraction that ignores fenced headings, resolved backlink context with source-line locations, and a split context pane whose links focus the editor or open the source note.
Added validated workspace settings IPC persisted under the Electron user-data directory for editor mode and context split visibility, while keeping routine status feedback non-modal.
limitations: The Electron binary is unavailable locally, so no visible launch, accessibility-tree or cross-platform UI automation was completed.
Settings persistence has contract and compile coverage but no restart fixture or visible runtime readback; tab/navigation state is currently session-scoped.
Full Markdown dialect rendering, command-palette coverage, remaining conflict/recovery and named UX surfaces, cross-platform behavior and reference Obsidian golden reopen tests remain pending.
